releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260816.14+81e903bd"
  - revision: "81e903bd"
  - timestamp: "Sun Aug 16 17:14:17 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #11 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- fix(oled): make the App IDs screen follow OLED mode
- feat(settings): drag tabs to reorder instead of arrow buttons
- fix(ci): stop attaching appID to release news items
- fix(settings): only show the nav bar when it is actually hidden
- fix(settings): stop writing bar appearance to the shared navigation bar
- added ios version below our version number
- fix: cert view doesnt need full auth so explicitly ignore provisioning, device registration
- added ability to show subnet mask on the deviceIP
- fix: temporarily reverting the no default overrideIP coz though our auto discovery works perfectly, localDevVPN is flawed in its routing table - so until it is fixed, to reduce friction we are okay with this
- refine more
- refined master switch for disabling app checks
- added master switch for disabling app checks
- more refinements in user cust screen icons
- fix button sizing in the source detail vc which shows "Free" for sources such as StikNES
- group few customizations stuff into own sections
- promote app verification into user cust + tie permission checks to app verification
- cleanup
- fix: move out widget shared defaults into widged manager
- bug-fix: app layer should be using Userdefaults.standard and not shared, unless it wants to share data with only other component being widgets
- promote permissions check from experimental to user cust
- fix: removebackup shouldnt throw if backup not found coz we fine
- refine the delete app dialog
- feat: added remove only (from sidestore) option when deleting app
- feat: added remove only (from sidestore) option when deleting app
- fix: widget reload was not invoked after resign causing issue coz we skip reload at end during resign/self install.
- moved export wireguard config into user customizations screen to be more accessible
- minimuxer: cpu 3% hog issue fix
- fix: emp - should invoke bind before we do intial handshake so that config is ready to be used in handshake.
- emp toggling requires a restart - so enforce it, by asking user, otherwise do not accept changes if they dont wanna do it now
- show reachability yes/no only when valid otherwise N/A
- improve messaging in footer (connection config)
- fix: removed defaultOverrideIP so that auto discovery may kick in
- qol: in connection config show override active or not only when present + show reachability
- fix: make ddi mount error not criticial
- minimuxer: use refined apis newly added in minimuxer for push based networking changes

#### Full Changelog: [e1d80daa...81e903bd](https://github.com/The-Big-Mini/MiniStore/compare/e1d80daaa74384cc2e8c3d345679cd4cc5c4404d...81e903bd588ecd03d2006cf343ec0b4e4e744cf3)
